source.paper: Shi et al. Nature Ecology & Evolution (2026)
source.title: Dynamic reorganization of three-dimensional genome architecture during Populus diversification

learning.input_contract: Forty official rows: ten P. koreana-to-other-species pairs times four A/B transition states; each row is a precomputed within-pair proportion.
learning.transform: Read ratios from Sup Tab5 and preserve values; verify each four-state group sums to one within 1e-12; no second normalization.
learning.join_order: Use author factor order Ppse, Pwua, Pyun, Psze, Plas, Psim, Pade, Pdav, Prot, Pqio; categories A-B, B-A, A-A, B-B. Bottom-to-top stack order is reversed by ggplot2 default.
learning.package_roles: ggplot2::geom_col and position_stack draw exact ratios; ggplot2::annotation_raster adds the ordinal Ks rank band on the same axes; ggplot2 scales format the 0-100 axis; BioFigure bf_render_png performs typography and layout preflight.
learning.layout_rules: One wide panel; four-item legend inside the top border; bars above a shallow peach Ks rank band; ten italic angled species labels below; panel tag b at the far upper-left; pure white canvas; 90 by 54 mm panel canvas inferred from the crop occupying about half of the full-width source figure.
learning.failure_modes: Reject incomplete states, wrong denominator, nonclosed groups, reordered species, palette drift, overlapping labels, and numeric Ks claims unsupported by source data.

scientific_scope.denominator: Homologous 40-kb bins within each species pair
scientific_scope.experimental_or_replicate_unit: No independent replicate claim; descriptive species-pair compositions only
scientific_scope.claim_boundary: No significance, confidence interval, or species-level replication inferred from bins
scientific_scope.ks_annotation: Species order is source-supported; numeric Ks values are absent from matched input. Band is an ordinal visual reconstruction only.

independent_transfer_status: not-tested; source and author figure were inspected before writing the independent renderer
